summary:
Plan for work-queue-5 (work-queue r1, r12) written up to one open question.
add numbers w<n> from the work-items under .shop/work/ (kind work-item, n from the w<n>.md name), writes w<n>.md with the title as heading, and prints the id.
The title keeps its one-entry check, so the r7 ../../w1 row still passes (the work-item's ruling).
A non-UTF-8 file found while numbering is refused under r7.
The test steps change in test_work_queue.py; the new steps go in tests/scenarios/work_queue_add_steps.py.
Question: the deprecated r2 and r7 'add when the work-item's file already exists' scenarios break under r1/r12, but the work-item has no Retires section.
questions: The deprecated scenarios 'add when the work-item's file already exists leaves the file as it was (deprecated)' (@r2) and '... is refused, saying so, with an error (deprecated)' (@r7) are 'Deprecated for: removal', but work-queue-5 has no Retires section, so the implementer may not retire them, and under r1/r12 neither can pass as it is. Reading A: the work-item gains a Retires section listing both, and they are removed with features retire. The narrator who runs `work add i1 w1 ...` beside an existing w1 sees w2.md written with the heading w1, `w2` printed, and exit 0. Reading B: they stay and must pass. add refuses a title equal to an existing work-item's id, so the narrator sees 'the work-item w1 already exists', an error exit and nothing changed, while any other title is numbered as r12 says.
